changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO provider (person_id, identifier, creator, date_created, retired, uuid) SELECT person_id, 'admin', user_id, NOW(), 0, 'ba1e27d3-2c89-49fc-9851-3b509abcce93' FROM users WHERE system_id = 'admin'

changeSet.author: act3
changeSet.comment: RHD Patient Information and RHD Research Participation get their own encounter types (DIGI-UW/openmrs-module-actcore#59), so each form can carry its own edit privilege. Liquibase runs before Initializer loads encountertypes/, so the two types are created here with the uuids rhd_encountertypes.csv gives them, which Initializer then finds and updates in place. Their existing encounters, saved under RHD Consultation Visit, move to them by the form that saved them. Initializer re-points the forms themselves when it loads ampathforms/.
